name: Sime Darby Property Berhad
summary: Sime Darby Property Berhad operates as a diversified real estate entity with a presence in Malaysia, Singapore, and the United Kingdom, involved in property development, real estate investment and asset management, and leisure and hospitality services. Sime Darby Property Berhad was founded in 1973 and is based in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.
